The series is trend-dominated with unstable ranking; a robust trimmed mean over the full pool may reduce variance and exploit many models.
The series has unstable ranking and strong trend; a per-horizon weighting might help, so try a weighted combo with softmax_neg_error on the full pool.
Try a per‑horizon weighted mean using the top‑k mean per horizon handle (w4) on the full pool to exploit horizon‑specific strengths in this trend‑dominated series.
The series is trend-dominated with unstable ranking; a robust non-weighted median may provide stability.
Test a simple weighted inverse_error on the full pool to see if basic error‑based weighting improves over softmax and top‑k mean, given the unstable ranking but strong trend dominance.
The series is trend-dominated with unstable ranking; a robust DBA combination on the full pool may outperform the current weighted w4.
trend_dominated and unstable ranking suggest a simple robust mean over the full pool may outperform weighted variants.
The series has unstable ranking and strong trend; a per‑horizon top‑k mean may capture horizon‑specific strengths, especially using the pool4 subset that already shows low correlation groups.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9503. Series context: trend strength 0.9199 and seasonal strength 0.3632; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.049); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.406.
